A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XVII · the infernal family

Devils

Five devilish monster girls: the mischievous lesser devil, the seductive succubus, the towering greater devil, the jack o'lantern who hides among the pumpkins and the hopping jiang shi. Tricksters and temptations, not villains.

Favourite food: Sweets: sugar, cookies and cake

The central similarity

Trouble with a sweet tooth.

Devils love mischief and sugar in equal measure. Each has her own kind of trouble; all of them can be bribed with sweets.

  • PranksStolen items, swapped hotbars, a shove into a pond: harmless chaos.
  • TemptationThe succubus charms players and climbs into their beds.
  • HidingThe jack o'lantern hides as a pumpkin; the jiang shi hops in the dark.
  • SweetsThe family food: sugar, cookies, cake and pumpkin pie.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a devil builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Sugar (+1), cookies (+1), cake (+3)
  • Laughing along (letting a prank happen without hitting her)

What costs trust

  • Hitting her
  • Holy water (a splash potion of healing)

Devoted (60+)

Her mischief turns on your enemies (hostile mobs near you are pranked: Slowness and Weakness), and she brings infernal presents (blaze powder, magma cream, nether quartz).

Mating & young

FormA single daughter. YoungA daughter, grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her mother. Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed. The succubus does not wait for high friendship.
2. ExpectingA day later her daughter is born.
3. MischiefThe young follow their mother and learn her tricks.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to her father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

PranksThe lesser devil steals an item from your hotbar and runs, swaps two hotbar slots, or pushes you. Catch her (hit or feed) to get it back.
CharmThe succubus' gaze slows a player (Slowness) as she approaches. At night she slips into their bed at any friendship, and is always expecting by morning.
HellfireThe greater devil is fireproof, strong and flies on great wings; she throws fireballs when angered.
Pumpkin disguiseThe jack o'lantern sits still as a carved pumpkin and creeps after players while they are not looking.
HoppingThe jiang shi moves only by hopping, arms stretched out. A paper talisman calms her.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Akaname: befriended, she scrubs the moss off the mossy stone near her friend
  • Lesser devil: pranks (steals from the hotbar, swaps slots, shoves); gives it back for a sweet or a hit
  • Succubus: slowing gaze at night, shares beds whatever her friendship
  • Greater devil: flies, fireproof, fireballs
  • Jack o'lantern: hides as a pumpkin, creeps after you unseen, glows at night
  • Jiang shi: moves only by hopping, hostile at night, calmed by paper
  • Devoted lesser devil pranks your enemies (Slowness, Weakness)
  • Kikimora: at night, befriended, she shuts the wooden doors, trapdoors and fence gates left open near her friend
  • Rokurokubi: after dark her neck stretches up high and the monsters near her friend glow
  • Ittan-momen: a girl trailing a cotton ribbon in place of legs; she flies, and a friend can ride her through the air
  • Chochin-obake: her lantern lights the night where she is; befriended, she keeps beside her friend through the dark
  • Gremlin: at night a wild one flips levers and swings doors (a cookie stops her for a day); befriended, furnaces near her friend cook twice as fast. Karakasa obake: befriended, her umbrella catches projectiles aimed at her friend
  • Oni: hostile at night, hits hard with an iron club; a honey bottle calms her, cocoa beans drive her off for a minute; befriended, she guards your door at night

Not yet

  • Stealing from chests

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The succubus ignores the high-friendship rule for bed sharing: that is her whole thing.

Open questions

  • Should the lesser devil be able to steal from chests too?
